Write a Matrix, Array, or DICOM Series to a DICOM File

Source: R/write.R
write_dicom.Rd

Creates a standard DICOM Part 10 Explicit VR Little Endian file from an R 2D matrix or 3D array of pixel values and an optional named list or character vector of DICOM metadata tags.

Usage

write_dicom(x, path, metadata = list())

Arguments

x

A numeric 2D matrix [rows, cols], 3D array [rows, cols, frames], or "dicom_pixels" object.

path

Output file path for the written .dcm file.

metadata

Named list or named character vector of DICOM tags/keywords and values (e.g., list(PatientName = "DOE^JOHN", Modality = "CT")).

Value

Invisibly returns the normalized output path.

Examples

mat <- matrix(seq(0, 255), nrow = 16, ncol = 16)
out <- tempfile(fileext = ".dcm")
write_dicom(mat, out, metadata = list(PatientName = "TEST^PATIENT", Modality = "CT"))
read_dicom(out, wide = TRUE)
